personal.title: Personal data
personal.summary: The facts you'd find on an ID card, and the details that make them feel real.

full_name.label: What's your full name?
full_name.hint: First, middle and last names, and any name you no longer use.

nickname.label: What do people call you?
nickname.hint: Nicknames, pet names, stage names. Who gets to use them, and who doesn't?

name_origin.label: Who chose your name, and why?
name_origin.hint: A grandmother, a saint, a song, a promise.

gender.label: How do you identify?
gender.hint: Your gender, and the pronouns to use in the text.

age.label: How old are you when the story begins?
age.hint: And at the end, if the story spans years.

birth_date.label: When were you born?
birth_date.hint: A year or a season will do. It keeps the timeline straight.

birthplace.label: Where were you born?
birthplace.hint: A city, a village, a ship, a planet.

nationality.label: What's your nationality?
nationality.hint: Or the people, realm or species you belong to.

home.label: Where do you live now, and with whom?
home.hint: A house, a rented room, a barracks, the street.

occupation.label: What do you do for a living?
occupation.hint: The real job, and the one you mention at parties.

education.label: What schooling have you had?
education.hint: Schools, teachers, apprenticeships, or what you taught yourself.

family_status.label: Do you have a partner, or children?
family_status.hint: A relationship, a marriage, a separation, a bereavement.

languages.label: What languages do you speak?
languages.hint: And which one comes out when you're angry.

money.label: How are you for money?
money.hint: Do you have it, want it, owe it? To whom?

physical.title: Physical features
physical.summary: How they look and live in their body, down to the details that stick.

first_impression.label: What's the first thing people notice about you?
first_impression.hint: Just one detail, the one that sticks.

height_build.label: What's your height and build?
height_build.hint: Height, weight, shoulders, hands. How much room you take up.

face.label: What's your face like?
face.hint: Shape, features, the expression you wear without thinking.

eyes.label: What are your eyes like?
eyes.hint: The colour, yes, but also the gaze: direct, evasive, tired.

hair.label: How do you wear your hair?
hair.hint: Colour, cut, how much care you give it. A beard too, if there is one.

skin.label: What's your skin like?
skin.hint: Complexion, freckles, lines, the marks of sun or cold.

distinguishing_marks.label: Any scars, tattoos or distinguishing marks?
distinguishing_marks.hint: And the story behind each one.

clothing.label: How do you usually dress?
clothing.hint: And what you wear when you want to impress, or disappear.

speaking_voice.label: What does your voice sound like?
speaking_voice.hint: Low, husky, bright. How it changes when you whisper or shout.

smell.label: What do you smell like?
smell.hint: Soap, tobacco, engine oil, wet earth.

health.label: How's your health?
health.hint: Illnesses, old injuries, disabilities, how you sleep and eat.

fitness.label: What can your body do, and what can't it?
fitness.hint: Strength, stamina, agility, reflexes. When do you run out of breath?

self_image.label: How do you feel about the way you look?
self_image.hint: Do you like it, hide it, fuss over it or ignore it?

behavior.title: Behaviours and attitudes
behavior.summary: How they move, speak and react: everything you can see from the outside, before you know who they are.

posture.label: How do you stand, and how do you sit?
posture.hint: Straight-backed, hunched, always leaning on something.

gait.label: How do you walk?
gait.hint: Briskly, shuffling, as if you owned the street.

gestures.label: What do your hands do while you talk?
gestures.hint: They wave, stay in your pockets, look for something to hold.

tics.label: Any tics or nervous habits?
tics.hint: Touching your hair, cracking your knuckles, checking the door.

way_of_speaking.label: How do you talk?
way_of_speaking.hint: Fast or slow, many words or few, a dialect, the words you overuse.

pet_phrases.label: Is there a phrase you keep using?
pet_phrases.hint: A filler word, a saying, a joke you always make.

laugh.label: How do you laugh, and at what?
laugh.hint: A laugh heard across the room, or a smile that barely shows.

with_strangers.label: How do you behave with strangers?
with_strangers.hint: Warmth, suspicion, a mask you only drop later.

under_pressure.label: What do you do under pressure?
under_pressure.hint: Freeze, take charge, crack jokes, run.

when_angry.label: What happens when you get angry?
when_angry.hint: You raise your voice, smile too much, go quiet.

when_lying.label: What gives you away when you lie?
when_lying.hint: A gesture, a pause, too many details.

habits.label: Which habits can't you break?
habits.hint: Coffee, cigarettes, a bedtime ritual, your phone.

typical_day.label: What does an ordinary day look like for you?
typical_day.hint: From waking up to lights out: the ordinary world the story is about to shake.

when_alone.label: What do you do when no one is watching?
when_alone.hint: The habits and weaknesses you hide in public.

psychology.title: Psychology
psychology.summary: The inner life: qualities and flaws, contradictions, fears, desires and the lie they believe.

temperament.label: How would someone who knows you well describe you?
temperament.hint: Three words, ideally not all flattering.

qualities.label: What are your best qualities?
qualities.hint: Courage, loyalty, wit, patience. And how they show in what you do.

flaws.label: And your flaws?
flaws.hint: The ones you admit to and the ones you can't see. The second kind is more useful to the story.

contradictions.label: Where do you contradict yourself?
contradictions.hint: A pacifist with road rage, a generous soul who can't ask for help.

self_perception.label: How do you see yourself, and how far is that from how others see you?
self_perception.hint: The gap between the two is often a story in itself.

emotions.label: What do you do with your feelings?
emotions.hint: Show them, hide them, turn them into something else. Which one gets away from you?

decisions.label: How do you make big decisions?
decisions.hint: On instinct or by reasoning, alone or by asking around.

fears.label: What are you afraid of?
fears.hint: One concrete fear (the dark, open water) and a deeper one (being abandoned, not mattering).

desires.label: What do you long for, even if you'd never say it?
desires.hint: The secret desire, not the goal you announce.

defenses.label: How do you protect yourself from getting hurt?
defenses.hint: Humour, control, escape, work: the defences you use without noticing.

shame.label: What are you ashamed of?
shame.hint: Even something small. Shame explains a lot of silences.

secret.label: What's your secret?
secret.hint: And what would happen if it came out.

the_lie.label: What lie do you believe about yourself or the world?
the_lie.hint: For example: “If I show weakness, they'll leave me.” It's what the story will put to the test.

ideas.title: Ideas and passions
ideas.summary: What they think, believe and love: the convictions that steer their choices.

beliefs.label: What do you believe in?
beliefs.hint: The ideas you won't compromise on.

faith.label: Where do you stand on faith?
faith.hint: Religion, spirituality, superstition, or none of them.

politics.label: What are your views on power and politics?
politics.hint: Which side you're on, and what it costs you to say so out loud.

red_line.label: What would you never do, not even to save yourself?
red_line.hint: The line the story might force you to cross.

role_models.label: Who do you admire?
role_models.hint: A real person, a figure from a book, an ancestor. And who you despise.

passions.label: What are you passionate about?
passions.hint: The thing you could talk about for hours.

talents.label: What are you genuinely good at?
talents.hint: A gift, a craft, a trick only you know.

hobbies.label: What do you do with your free time?
hobbies.hint: If you have any. And what the way you spend it says about you.

favorites.label: What are your favourite things?
favorites.hint: A book, a song, a dish, a place, a time of day.

dislikes.label: What can't you stand?
dislikes.hint: From injustice to people who chew with their mouths open.

strong_opinions.label: What do you have strong opinions about that nobody asked for?
strong_opinions.hint: The small crusades that reveal a character.

treasured_possession.label: What would you save from a fire?

dreams.label: What do you dream of doing someday?
dreams.hint: The dream you set aside, or the one you're still chasing.

sociology.title: Sociology
sociology.summary: Where they come from and who they live among: family, class, friends, the groups they belong to.

social_background.label: What kind of background do you come from?
social_background.hint: Class, neighbourhood, what your parents did, how many books were in the house.

social_position.label: And where do you stand today?
social_position.hint: Higher, lower or right where you started. And what it cost you.

parents.label: Who are your parents, and how do you get on with them?
parents.hint: Or whoever raised you. Present, absent, idealised.

siblings.label: Do you have brothers or sisters?
siblings.hint: Where you fall among them, the alliances, the jealousies.

family_role.label: What role do you play in your family?
family_role.hint: The one who holds it together, the black sheep, the peacemaker, the one who left.

love_life.label: Who do you love, or who have you loved?
love_life.hint: Relationships, unrequited love, the one that ended badly.

friends.label: Who are your closest friends?
friends.hint: And what they know about you that others don't.

enemies.label: Do you have enemies?
enemies.hint: Open or hidden, and where the bad blood began.

work_relationships.label: How do you get on with colleagues and bosses?
work_relationships.hint: Who gives the orders, who follows them, who overshadows you.

communities.label: Which groups or communities do you belong to?
communities.hint: A family, a guild, a church, a team, a gang.

reputation.label: What do people say about you when you're not around?

trust.label: Who do you trust, and why?
trust.hint: And who could betray you without you seeing it coming.

out_of_place.label: Where do you feel out of place?
out_of_place.hint: The setting where you never know how to behave.

backstory.title: Life before the story
backstory.summary: The years the story never shows, which explain who they are when it begins.

upbringing.label: Where did you grow up, and in what kind of home?
upbringing.hint: The place, the people, the mood in the house.

earliest_memory.label: What's your earliest memory?
earliest_memory.hint: An image, a smell, a voice.

childhood.label: What were you like as a child?
childhood.hint: What delighted you, what frightened you, what you weren't allowed to do.

formative_people.label: Who raised you, and who shaped you?
formative_people.hint: A parent, a teacher, a friend, an enemy.

adolescence.label: What were your teenage years like?
adolescence.hint: Rebellions, first choices, the person you wanted to become.

first_love.label: Who was your first love?
first_love.hint: And what they taught you, for better or worse.

defining_moment.label: What moment changed the course of your life?
defining_moment.hint: A choice, an accident, a meeting, a piece of news.

losses.label: Who or what have you lost?
losses.hint: People, places, chances, a version of yourself.

wound.label: What wound do you still carry?
wound.hint: The past event behind your fears and the lie you believe.

proudest_moment.label: What are you proudest of?
proudest_moment.hint: Even if nobody knows about it.

regret.label: What do you regret?
regret.hint: Something you did, or something you never had the nerve to do.

unfinished_business.label: What did you leave unfinished?
unfinished_business.hint: A debt, a promise, a letter never sent.

day_before.label: What were you doing the day before the story began?

conflict.title: Conflict
conflict.summary: What they want, what they need and what stands in the way: the engine of their story.

want.label: What do you want in this story?
want.hint: A concrete, visible goal: win the race, find your sister, get off the island.

why_now.label: Why now?
why_now.hint: What makes waiting any longer impossible.

need.label: What do you actually need, even if you don't know it yet?
need.hint: Often the opposite of the lie you believe: to forgive, to ask for help, to let go.

obstacle.label: What's stopping you from getting it?
obstacle.hint: People, places, laws, time running out.

antagonist.label: Who opposes you, and what are their reasons?
antagonist.hint: Whoever stands in your way wants something too.

inner_obstacle.label: What holds you back from the inside?
inner_obstacle.hint: A fear, a flaw, a misplaced loyalty.

stakes.label: What do you lose if you fail?

worst_case.label: What's the worst thing that could happen to you?
worst_case.hint: Sooner or later, the story should bring you close to it.

plan.label: How are you going to pull it off?
plan.hint: The opening plan, which probably won't work.

sacrifice.label: What would you be willing to give up?
sacrifice.hint: And what you'd never let go of.

dilemma.label: What impossible choice will you face?
dilemma.hint: Two things you care about that can't both survive.

victory.label: What would winning look like?
victory.hint: And what if getting what you want isn't enough?

evolution.title: Evolution during the story
evolution.summary: How they change from the first scene to the last, and at what cost.

arc_type.label: What kind of arc do you follow?
arc_type.hint: Positive if you change for the better, negative if you fall, flat if your convictions hold and the world around you changes instead.

arc_start.label: Who are you when the story begins?
arc_start.hint: What you believe, what you lack, what you refuse to see.

catalyst.label: What pushes you out of your ordinary life?
catalyst.hint: The event that makes staying the same impossible.

resistance.label: How do you resist change?
resistance.hint: The excuses, the escapes, the steps back.

first_doubt.label: When do you first doubt the lie you believe?
first_doubt.hint: A crack, not yet a turning point.

turning_point.label: When do you change direction?
turning_point.hint: The scene where you choose differently from how you would have at the start.

darkest_moment.label: What's your darkest moment?
darkest_moment.hint: When all seems lost and the old lie looks true again.

cost_of_change.label: What did changing cost you?
cost_of_change.hint: A relationship, a certainty, a part of yourself.

arc_end.label: Who are you at the end?
arc_end.hint: The distance from the beginning is your arc.

what_remains.label: What stays the same, despite everything?
what_remains.hint: The core that keeps you recognisable to the very end.

seen_by_others.label: How do others notice you've changed?
seen_by_others.hint: A look, a remark, someone who no longer recognises you.

final_image.label: What's the last image we have of you?

gameplay.title: Role in the game
gameplay.summary: What they do in the game: role, abilities and progression, and how the mechanics show who they are.

playable.label: Are you a playable character?
playable.hint: Or a companion, an NPC, an antagonist, a boss.

game_role.label: What's your function in the game?
game_role.hint: Guide, merchant, rival, quest giver, squadmate, recurring enemy.

first_encounter.label: Where and when does the player first meet you?
first_encounter.hint: The scene, the level, the moment. First impressions count double.

presence.label: Which parts of the game are you in?
presence.hint: Acts, chapters, quests. And whether you can leave before the end.

party_role.label: What's your role in the party?
party_role.hint: Tank, healer, support, damage, scout. Only if you fight alongside the player.

abilities.label: What can you do?
abilities.hint: Skills, powers, talents the player will see in action.

combat_style.label: How do you fight?
combat_style.hint: Up close, at range, from the shadows, with magic, with words. Or not at all.

signature_move.label: Do you have a signature move?
signature_move.hint: A strike, a trick, a gesture the player will recognise at once.

weaknesses.label: What are your weak points?
weaknesses.hint: In combat and out of it: an element, a weapon, a person, a memory.

equipment.label: What do you carry?
equipment.hint: Weapons, tools, key items, and the one thing you'd never leave behind.

progression.label: How do you grow over the course of the game?
progression.hint: Levels, unlocked skills, gear. Ideally, mechanical growth follows the story's.

player_bond.label: How does your relationship with the player change?
player_bond.hint: Trust, approval, romance, betrayal: what strengthens it and what breaks it.

player_choices.label: Which of the player's choices affect you?
player_choices.hint: Whether you can die, leave or switch sides. The state variables tied to you.

mechanics_and_character.label: Do your mechanics reflect who you are?
mechanics_and_character.hint: A cautious character who plays recklessly will feel wrong.

voice.title: Voice and performance
voice.summary: How they should sound: notes for whoever writes their lines, for casting and for the voice director.

voice_type.label: What kind of voice are we casting for you?
voice_type.hint: Pitch and timbre: deep and gravelly, bright and quick, warm, metallic.

vocal_age.label: How old does your voice sound?
vocal_age.hint: It doesn't always match the character's age, and that's fine.

accent.label: Do you have an accent?
accent.hint: Regional, foreign, invented for the game's world. And whether it carries over into other languages.

delivery.label: How do you deliver your lines?
delivery.hint: Pace, pauses, volume: measured, torrential, dry, clipped.

vocabulary.label: What kind of words do you use?
vocabulary.hint: Formal or slang, archaic, technical. Swearing or not.

catchphrase.label: Do you have a catchphrase?
catchphrase.hint: A recurring line players will end up quoting.

emotional_range.label: What emotional range does your voice need?
emotional_range.hint: From a whisper to a scream: the extremes the role demands.

sample_barks.label: What barks will we hear from you?
sample_barks.hint: Short gameplay lines: an attack, taking a hit, finding an item, the player standing idle too long.

efforts.label: What sounds do you make besides words?
efforts.hint: Breaths, laughs, grunts, screams, sighs: the efforts to record in the booth.

voice_references.label: Who do you sound like?
voice_references.hint: Actors, characters, reference performances for casting.

localization_notes.label: What should your translators know?
localization_notes.hint: Wordplay, names to keep, accents to adapt.

direction_notes.label: What should your voice actor know?
direction_notes.hint: Intent, subtext, the mistake to avoid.
